svg.aria-label: Codevira solution blueprint: a persistent-memory and decision-enforcement layer for AI coding agents. Five pillars, a four-level escalation from remembering a decision to blocking an edit, eight capabilities around a central hub, who it is for, what you get, how you stay in control, the platform foundation, and an eight-step lifecycle.
svg.title: Codevira — solution blueprint: persistent memory and decision enforcement for AI coding agents
svg.desc: A light-themed product poster for Codevira, a local-first MCP server that gives every AI coding agent on a machine one shared in-repo memory of the decisions made and why. The header carries the title SOLUTION BLUEPRINT, the subtitle PERSISTENT MEMORY + DECISION ENFORCEMENT FOR AI CODING AGENTS, the tagline 'One memory. Every AI tool. Decisions that stick.', and five pillar chips: local-first, enforced, cross-tool, model-free, auditable. Below it a four-stage escalation bar runs L1 REMEMBER, L2 SURFACE, L3 WARN, L4 BLOCK. The middle of the sheet is a hub and spoke: a blue-to-violet ring holding the Codevira mark and the line 'One shared decision log for every AI tool', with four capability cards spoked in from the left (Decision Memory, Cross-Tool Sync, Session Context, Code Graph) and four from the right (Enforcement Engine, Anti-Regression, Skill Library, Working Memory). The left rail lists who it is for and which tools it works with, over MCP or via AGENTS.md; the right rail lists six things you get and five ways you stay in control. Three full-width bands close the sheet: nine parts of the loop, eight platform foundations, and an eight-step lifecycle from Init through Record, Generate, Inject, Intercept, Enforce and Observe to Learn.
svg.text: BUILT FOR EVERY PART OF THE LOOP
